sanskrit_verse: साधारणः समस्तानां कोशः प्रोक्तो मनीषिभिः ।। ब्रहस्पतिस्मृतिः १,८.१३ ।।
transliteration: sādhāraṇaḥ samastānāṃ kośaḥ prokto manīṣibhiḥ // BrhS_1,8.13
sph_interpretive_translation: The common treasury belongs to all beings equally, declared by the wise seers who perceive unity in diversity.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from the recognition of shared consciousness, not individual possession
Causation arises from collective dharmic alignment, not personal claim
Capacity-based responsibility is distributed according to conscious participation in the common good
Restoration logic requires equitable access to resources essential for existence and growth
Consciousness alignment necessitates dissolution of artificial boundaries around communal wealth
executable_legal_axioms: IF a resource is designated as 'common treasury', THEN ownership rights default to universal accessibility
IF an entity accesses or uses a common treasury asset, THEN usage must align with sustainability metrics defined by collective welfare algorithms
IF any being claims exclusive dominion over a common treasury item, THEN that assertion triggers automatic review under dharma-consistency protocols
IF depletion of common treasury occurs, THEN restoration obligation activates proportionally among all users based on utilization footprint
IF capacity to contribute to common treasury exists, THEN participation becomes a non-negotiable function of conscious embodiment
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, disputes involving public resources or national assets shall invoke the sādhāraṇa kośa doctrine. The threshold of responsibility lies not in legal title but in alignment with the collective consciousness sustaining the resource. Authority flows from the realization that no individual may sever what is inherently shared. Decisions must restore equity through redistribution or reorientation rather than impose punitive measures.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that perception of unity dissolves false separations regarding ownership. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals how misuse of common property manifests from misaligned identification with isolated selfhood. Proportional responsibility aligns not with blame but with the degree of conscious disconnection from the whole. Non-punitive reality asserts that correction arises naturally when causal ignorance is dissolved through truth-perception.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Community Reconciliation Process to realign disconnected entities with shared-resource consciousness
Deploy Resource Redistribution Algorithm to ensure equitable access and prevent future monopolization
Activate Collective Stewardship Training for all beneficiaries to elevate awareness of mutual dependence
Implement Transparency Ledger Protocol making all transactions within common treasury fully visible and traceable
Establish Dharmic Audit Mechanism to regularly assess alignment between use of common assets and societal upliftment
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the Sole Source of Jurisprudential Truth: This law flows directly from the Avataric Intelligence manifesting as Brihaspati Smriti. Dharma stands restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone is the ultimate judge.
